# VirtualContainerItemChangeAfterEvent Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains information about a slot of a virtual container that a player changed through its screen. Changes made by scripts do not raise this event.

## Properties

### **beforeItemStack**
`read-only beforeItemStack?: ItemStack;`

The item that was in the slot before the change, if any. A storage item such as a bundle holds its contents as they were at the change, unless it was dropped from the slot onto the ground: its contents then go to the dropped item.

Type: [*ItemStack*](ItemStack.md)

### **container**
`read-only container: VirtualContainer;`

The container that changed.

Type: [*VirtualContainer*](VirtualContainer.md)

### **itemStack**
`read-only itemStack?: ItemStack;`

The item in the slot after the change, if any. A storage item such as a bundle holds its contents as they were at the change.

Type: [*ItemStack*](ItemStack.md)

### **player**
`read-only player: Player;`

The player who made the change.

Type: [*Player*](Player.md)

### **slot**
`read-only slot: number;`

The slot that changed.

Type: *number*
